summary: Gentherm closed its acquisition of Modine's spun-off Performance Technologies business on October 1, 2026, via a merger of a Gentherm subsidiary into SpinCo, which became Modine Global, Incorporated. Modine shareholders received one SpinCo share per Modine share on a September 28, 2026 record date, then exchanged each SpinCo share for 0.44619 Gentherm shares plus cash in lieu of fractional shares. No price, premium, advisor, or expected-close beyond the closing is stated in the excerpt. Watch integration execution, leverage from the debt financing, and any post-close overhang given newly issued Gentherm stock.
